subject: Vendor onboarding & PO path for WPCloud marketplace listings
body:
From: Sam Lewis <procurement@wpcloud.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding checklist for Marketplace procurement path

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Were starting vendor setup for WPCloud so we can list Redwood Inference on our managed marketplace and route POs via our procurement system. Can you send the exact checklist + the PO acceptance flow so our legal and finance teams can prep? Specifically: seller registration steps for AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces, required tax forms, banking/payment setup, and any standard MSA or procurement language.

Appreciate it —
Sam Lewis
Head of Procurement, WPCloud
procurement@wpcloud.com

---
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sam Lewis <procurement@wpcloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding checklist for Marketplace procurement path

Hi Sam —

Thanks — attaching our vendor registration workbook (Redwood_Vendor_Registration_Form.xlsx). High-level procurement path weve used successfully with other marketplace partners:

1) Registration & Tax:
- Complete vendor workbook + upload W-9 (US) or W-8BEN (non-US).
- Provide EIN/Tax ID and remittance banking details (ACH preferred).

2) Legal & MSA:
- We use a standard Redwood MSA; we can sign via DocuSign. If WPCloud requires a counter-signed SOW or marketplace-specific Addendum, please share. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/ABCD-ef12

3) PO routing & invoicing:
- WPCloud creates PO referencing our Redwood vendor code. We accept POs via: email vendor-payments@redwood.com OR via the marketplace billing integration (AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, GCP Marketplace).
- For AWS: typically list as SaaS or AMI depending on implementation; payouts go through Seller Central (ensure your marketplace admin enables our seller record).
- For Azure: submit Seller ID and marketplace offer details; Payouts may route through Microsoft commerce or direct invoicing depending on the plan.
- For GCP: partner pact and billing account attachment required for marketplace listing.

4) Marketplace-specific items to prepare (per provider):
- AWS: Seller Central registration, tax forms, pricing models (metered vs subscription), and security attestation for listing.
- Azure: Partner Center registration, offer package, and commercial marketplace onboarding form.
- GCP: Partner Advantage enrollment, SaaS listing config, and cloud billing account linkage.

5) Timeline & next steps:
- Fill the attached workbook and return by EOD Mon (4/5)
- Well route MSA via DocuSign, and Marissa (ccd) will open the internal PO acceptance ticket and share the PO template.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Registration_Form.xlsx

If you want, we can do a 30-minute sync with legal + finance to walk through the forms.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: Sam Lewis <procurement@wpcloud.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Kate Huang <kate@wpcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:09:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding checklist for Marketplace procurement path

Hi Vanessa,

We received the workbook and uploaded our part (see attached WPCloud_Vendor_Form.pdf). A few clarifying Qs from finance:
- For AWS marketplace purchases, do we need to issue POs to Redwood directly or to the AWS billing entity? Our procurement typically routes POs to vendors; AWS billing sometimes requires POs to reference the AWS invoice ID.
- Whats your standard net payment term for marketplace-driven deals? We usually need a 45-day term for marketplace pilots.
- Can Redwood accept a marketplace-managed billing flow (i.e., rebates/marketplace credit) or do you require direct invoices?

Wed also like to confirm an owner who will accept the PO and ingest it into your AP system so we can close our side quickly.

Thanks,
Sam

Attachment: WPCloud_Vendor_Form.pdf (PDF)

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sam Lewis <procurement@wpcloud.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:30:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding checklist for Marketplace procurement path

Hi Sam,

Thanks for uploading the form. Im Redwoods Finance & Marketplace Enablement lead and Ill own PO intake for this listing. Quick answers:

- PO recipient: send POs to vendor-payments@redwood.com with the subject line: "WPCloud PO - [PO NUMBER]". If the PO is marketplace-managed (AWS/Azure/GCP), include the marketplace invoice or order ID in the body and well map it to the internal invoice.

- Payment terms: standard is Net 30. We can extend to Net 45 for initial pilots on a case-by-case basis (finance approval required). Please attach a purchase order and indicate Net 45 in the terms section; I will route for approval.

- Marketplace-managed billing: We support both flows. For AWS and Azure, we can accept marketplace invoices (Marketplace-B2B) and reconcile via the seller portal. For GCP marketplace, we typically prefer direct invoicing for early pilots, but we can integrate with GCP billing on production rollouts.

Required items to accept PO and create account:
- Completed vendor workbook + W-9 / W-8
- Signed MSA (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/tx/ABCD-ef12)
- Remittance bank details (ACH) or wire instructions
- Quote or offer ID if listing on marketplace portal

Ive attached a PO template (PO_Template_WPCloud_12345.pdf) you can use to route through WPCloud procurement. Once we receive the PO, allow 3 business days for AP to set up the vendor record and enable billing.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Sam/Kate: return signed MSA + completed workbook + bank details.
2) Marissa: confirm payment terms and open vendor record upon receiving the PO.
3) Vanessa & Jonas: coordinate technical listing requirements with WPCloud marketplace team (pricing model, metering, security checklist).

Looping Jonas (partner ops) to coordinate the seller-side listing configs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Finance & Marketplace Enablement
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: PO_Template_WPCloud_12345.pdf
